prompt_en: A Hue royal court music ensemble performing in a gilded palace hall.
refined_prompt: A Hue royal court music ensemble, known as Nhã Nhạc—a UNESCO World Heritage site—performs in a gilded palace hall. The ensemble includes traditional Vietnamese instruments like the dan ty ba (three-stringed zither) and tranh (16-stringed zither). Musicians and dancers, dressed in elaborate court attire with intricate embroidery and flowing fabrics, gracefully move to the rhythm of elegant music that has been a part of Vietnamese court life since the 13th century. Nhã Nhạc not only serves as a performance art but also as a cultural ambassador, embodying the rich history and heritage of Vietnam in both traditional and contemporary settings.
